description: Golden question/reference set for RAGAS evaluation of the Scatterbrain RAG pipeline. The corpus is fictional so answers must come from retrieved context, not model prior knowledge.

samples.user_input: How many days of paid annual leave do full-time employees get?
samples.reference: Full-time employees receive 28 days of paid annual leave per calendar year.

samples.user_input: What temperature range must pharmaceutical storage zones be kept in?
samples.reference: Pharmaceutical storage zones must be kept between 2 and 8 degrees Celsius.

samples.user_input: What must a shift supervisor do if a storage zone is out of range for more than 15 minutes?
samples.reference: The shift supervisor must move the affected stock to the backup cold room and file an incident report within 24 hours.

samples.user_input: What is the daily meal allowance for business travel within the Baltic states?
samples.reference: The daily meal allowance within the Baltic states is 45 euros.

samples.user_input: Where is Harborlight Logistics headquartered and when did it move there?
samples.reference: Harborlight Logistics has been headquartered in Riga, Latvia, since it moved there in 2019.

samples.user_input: How often must forklift operators renew their certification?
samples.reference: Forklift operators must renew their certification every 3 years.
